The Engineering Acceleration team builds and operates the foundational systems that engineers use to build, test, and ship ChatGPT, the API, and OpenAI's infrastructure.

We are looking for an engineer to help evolve OpenAI's build and continuous integration systems for a fast-growing engineering organization. This role sits at the intersection of developer productivity, build systems, distributed infrastructure, and software quality. You will work on the systems that determine how quickly and confidently engineers can move: Bazel-based builds, Buildkite pipelines, test selection, remote caching and execution, CI observability, and tooling that helps engineers understand and fix failures quickly.

Our mission is to make OpenAI one of the most productive engineering organizations in the world while preserving a high bar for correctness, reliability, and safety. - Bazel and Starlark for build and test workflows

- Python, Go, TypeScript, Rust, C++, and other languages in a large monorepo

jobs.description: Intelligent machines powered by artificial intelligence—computers that can learn, reason, and interact with people—are transforming every industry. GPU-accelerated deep learning provides the foundation for machines to perceive, reason, and solve complex problems. NVIDIA GPUs run deep learning algorithms that simulate aspects of human intelligence, acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. We are seeking an exceptional Senior Perception Engineer to help design and productize NVIDIA’s next-generation autonomous driving perception stack. You will work on the core 3D obstacle perception pipeline, contribute to architecture and algorithm design, and remain deeply hands-on with implementation, including modern transformer-based, multi-modal, and vision-language techniques where they add real value. What you’ll be doing: Develop and improve the technical design, architecture, and roadmap for 3D obstacle perception to support end-to-end autonomous driving functionalities, leveraging state-of-the-art CNN and transformer-based architectures where appropriate. Design and implement advanced 3D perception models using multi-camera inputs and/or multi-sensor fusion (camera, radar, lidar) for obstacle detection and tracking, including opportunities to explore BEV and transformer-based 3D perception. Build efficient, production-grade deep learning models: define objectives with the team, select and prototype architectures, run experiments, and follow best practices for training and evaluation, using techniques such as large-scale pretraining, distillation, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA). Help define and maintain KPI frameworks to quantify perception performance; analyze large-scale real and synthetic datasets to identify failure modes and systematically improve accuracy, robustness, and efficiency, incorporating approaches like self-supervised and representation learning when beneficial. Contribute to the data strategy for perception: specify data and labeling requirements, help prioritize data collection and annotation, and collaborate with data and ground-truth teams, including model-assisted workflows (e.g., active learning, auto-labeling, vision-language models (VLMs)) and model-in-the-loop tooling. Collaborate with safety, systems, and software teams to ensure perception solutions meet product requirements for safety, latency, resource usage, and software robustness, and are ready for deployment at scale. What we need to see: PhD with 4+ years, MS with 6+ years, or BS (or equivalent experience) with 8+ years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. Hands-on experience developing deep learning–based perception or closely related systems for complex real-world problems, with strong proficiency in frameworks such as PyTorch and a track record of taking models from prototype to production. Proven experience in data-driven development, including close collaboration with data, labeling, and ground-truth teams on data strategy, labeling quality, and iterative model improvement. Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++, with experience building reliable, high-performance, production-quality software. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Experience designing and deploying perception solutions for autonomous driving or robotics using camera-based deep learning at scale. Hands-on experience architecting and deploying DNN-based perception pipelines on embedded or real-time platforms, including optimization for latency, memory, and compute constraints, and experience with modern architectures such as CNNs and transformers, plus familiarity with techniques like large-scale pretraining, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA), or vision-language models (VLMs). Strong publication record or recognized contributions in deep learning, computer vision, or autonomous systems at leading conferences/journals (e.g., CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, IROS). Deep understanding of 3D computer vision fundamentals, including camera modeling and calibration (intrinsic and extrinsic), multi-view geometry, and 3D representations, ideally with experience applying these concepts in transformer-based 3D or BEV perception pipelines. Experience with CUDA development and optimizing training or inference pipelines through custom CUDA kernels or other GPU-accelerated components. #AutonomousVehicles Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure behind Amazon's global data centers — and your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

Students who have completed — or due to complete before the internship end date — a higher education qualification (National Qualifications Framework level 4 to 6) or a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronic Engineering or similar fields.

About the Role

As an intern, you will provide technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers. Your work will ensure that the data center's mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups on site.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

The Engineering Operations team is Amazon's front-line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. You will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. This equipment includes, but is not limited to:

- Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear

- Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs)

- Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers

- Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)

- Building automation systems

Your day-to-day duties include:

- Maintaining mechanical and electrical equipment

- Assisting with root cause analysis of equipment failures

- Troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)

- Taking daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment

- Using internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows

- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for six consecutive months, starting in March/April 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday.

Please note that full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Amazon does not sponsor immigration for this role.

South Africa Employment Equity Requirements

In line with applicable legislation, preference will be given to eligible applicants from designated groups (that is, Black people (used as a collective term for Africans, Colored, Indians and Chinese) women, and persons with disabilities who are citizens of South Africa). Appointments will be made on merit and in accordance with organizational requirements.

- Be a South African citizen with a valid Identity Document

- Unemployed before joining the internship program.

- Age requirement: below 35 years

- Must have completed a higher education qualification in a related field (Minimum NQF level 4-6 qualification)

- Qualification must be from an accredited institution of higher education

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will troubleshoot and maintain the systems that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at a massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you maintain power it all.

Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

Riot Games Sydney is looking for a Principal QA Engineer to help transform how we approach quality across teams. Sydney partners with Riot teams globally and contributes across games and technology spaces including VALORANT, League of Legends, Teamfight Tactics, and broader R&D and tech initiatives.

At Riot, quality is more than defect discovery. It is a set of values, practices, and behaviors that shape how we build, decide, and deliver for players.

As a Principal QA Engineer, you will own the quality approach for our teams or product spaces and operate as a senior craft leader with dev studio and business-unit level influence. This role will work closely with and adjacent to the Senior Leadership Team in Sydney, helping shape strategic quality direction across the organisation. You will help teams shift quality left through stronger test automation, better tooling, clearer standards, and practical quality strategies that improve both developer experience and player experience. You will also help teams maintain confidence in quality in a world of AI-assisted development, where new tooling and workflows are changing how software is designed, implemented, and validated.

This is a full-time role, based in Sydney, Australia.

Responsibilities:

• Own the quality approach for teams or product areas and ensure quality activities are considered across every stage of the software development lifecycle.
• Lead initiatives that shift quality left through automation, tooling, and process improvements that help engineers catch issues earlier and ship with more confidence.
• Identify, create, and evolve test frameworks and automation strategies that improve speed, coverage, sustainability, and reliability release over release.
• Help define and implement test approaches as part of an overall quality and test strategy.
• Help shape our approach to quality in an evolving AI landscape, including how teams use AI-assisted workflows responsibly and effectively while maintaining confidence in what we ship.
• Use metrics and reporting to surface quality risks, trends, and opportunities, then turn those insights into action with product and discipline leaders.
• Provide craft leadership and coaching for QA and partner disciplines, strengthening test design, planning, execution, and quality decision-making.
• Help define, adapt, and socialise quality standards and practices that are usable across multiple teams and scalable at product or business-unit level.
• Partner with engineering, delivery, design, creative, and production leaders to diagnose product and project quality risks and recommend targeted improvements.
• Contribute to growing the quality craft through hiring, mentorship, and cross-team leadership.
• Work in partnership with Game and Central teams to drive strategic initiatives.

Required Qualifications:

• 8+ years of software quality assurance or quality engineering experience, with multiple proven product successes.
• Experience defining and implementing test approaches as part of an overall test strategy.
• Experience coaching QA team members on test design, planning, and execution.
• Experience driving continuous improvement processes within a team or organization.
• Experience leading or maturing automated testing frameworks, tools, or processes that improve sustainable development.
• Experience using quality metrics, telemetry, or reporting to assess quality health and influence decisions.
• Experience working effectively across disciplines and influencing teams beyond direct reporting lines.
• Experience handling multiple simultaneous projects and partners
• Experience tasking or partnering with remote teams and providing feedback on effectiveness.
• Experience establishing product or business-unit quality standards, practices, or operating models.
• History of leading strategic quality initiatives with broad organisational impact.
• Strong judgment in ambiguous problem spaces, with the ability to evaluate, scope, and execute solutions with team, initiative, or business-unit impact.
• Strong technical acumen, with the ability to engage deeply with engineers on systems, tooling, automation, and development workflows.
• The ability to adapt quality strategy to emerging development practices, including AI-assisted workflows and automation.

Desired Qualifications:

• Experience in game development environments and supporting or shipping games.
• Development or quality experience across multiple platforms such as mobile, console, and PC.
• Familiarity with CI/CD maturity, release quality, and build or delivery workflows.
• Familiarity with Unreal and/or other game engines.
• Relevant certifications such as ISTQB Foundation, ISTQB Agile Tester, ISTQB Expert Level, ISTQB Advanced Test Manager, or ICAgile Test Expert.

For this role, you’ll find success through:

• Deep quality craft expertise and a strong point of view on how to build quality into development, not inspect it in the end.
• Strong technical credibility with engineers and the ability to translate quality goals into practical technical solutions.
• The ability to make a meaningful impact on how teams work and on the quality of the end product at a business-unit level.
• A collaborative style that helps engineers and partner disciplines feel ownership of quality outcomes.
• Decision-making that consistently prioritizes better developer workflows and better player experiences.
• The ability to operate as a recognised craft expert across multiple dimensions of QA engineering.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Our Perks:

At Riot we strongly believe in work / life balance, and we encourage that with our open paid time off policy, paid parental leave (for both primary and secondary carers) and flexible work schedules to fit your lifestyle. We also believe that work should be fun, we have co-op gaming areas, a play fund so you can broaden and deepen your knowledge of players and community, and all the snacks you would ever need to power through your day (even healthy snacks!). And that’s not all we offer, there’s also:

• Medical Insurance that covers you and your dependents
• Employee Assistance Program
• Wellness fund
• Donation matching of time and money to registered charities
• Learning and Development opportunities

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

You are accountable for driving optimized, sustained clinical utilization of icobrain across your accounts, and for translating that utilization into high year-over-year renewal rates and expanding clinical adoption within each institution.

What you'll do

Own account health and renewals

• Serve as the primary post-sale relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of icobrain customers, from radiology and neurology leadership to IT, PACS administrators, and MR technologists.
• Build and execute account-level success plans with defined utilization targets, clinical adoption milestones, and renewal timelines.
• Monitor utilization data continuously, identify accounts trending toward under-use or risk, and drive corrective action well ahead of renewal.
• Deliver year-over-year renewal performance and grow clinical utilization — more indications, more referring clinicians, more scans analyzed — within existing accounts.
• Run structured business reviews that connect icobrain output to the customer's own clinical and operational goals.

Lead manual quality control

• Execute manual quality control review on all new customer implementations to confirm that image acquisition protocols, data flow, and report output meet icobrain specifications from day one.
• Perform targeted QC on designated icobrain modules and workflows for existing customers, identifying protocol drift, acquisition issues, or integration faults that degrade result quality.
• Document QC findings, drive remediation with the customer and internal teams, and feed recurring issues back to product and engineering to improve the working model.
• Refine and standardize QC methodology and documentation as volume grows; train others on the process.

Maintain visibility and cross-functional alignment

• Own and operate a repeatable process that keeps assigned accounts visible to the organization — current status, utilization trends, open issues, risk level, and renewal outlook available to sales, service, and leadership at any time.
• Partner closely with the GE HealthCare–icometrix sales team on renewals, expansion opportunities, and account transitions from pre-sale to post-sale.
• Coordinate across GE HealthCare support functions — technical support, field service, clinical applications, IT/integration, regulatory, and marketing — to resolve customer issues and remove adoption barriers.
• Serve as the voice of the customer internally, escalating clearly and advocating for fixes and enhancements with evidence.

Lead without formal authority

• Set the standard for customer engagement quality and mentor other customer success team members on playbooks, QC execution, and escalation handling.
• Contribute to building the scalable infrastructure of the function: onboarding templates, health-scoring criteria, QC checklists, and reporting cadence.

What you'll bring

Required

• 5+ years in customer success, clinical applications, clinical education, or account management within medical imaging, medical device, healthcare IT, or clinical software.
• Demonstrated ownership of renewal outcomes and measurable adoption or utilization growth across a customer portfolio.
• Proven ability to build trusted relationships with clinical stakeholders — radiologists, neurologists, imaging directors — and with technical stakeholders such as PACS and IT administrators.
• Strong process discipline: you can design, document, and consistently run a repeatable customer management and reporting process.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, including comfort presenting to physician and executive audiences.
• Ability to work effectively across a large, matrixed organization to get things done.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
• Ability to travel 10% of the time.

Strongly preferred

• Direct neuroimaging experience — brain MRI acquisition, protocol optimization, or quantitative neuroimaging analysis.
• Clinical or technical credentials such as RT(R)(MR), radiologic technologist, MR physicist, or a neuroscience/neurology background.
• Working familiarity with MS, dementia and Alzheimer's disease, ARIA monitoring in the context of amyloid-targeting therapy, epilepsy, or TBI imaging workflows.
• Experience with DICOM, PACS integration, and clinical data workflows.
• Experience introducing AI or quantitative imaging software into clinical practice, including change management with skeptical clinical users.
• Familiarity with CRM and customer success tooling for health scoring and portfolio reporting.
• Ability to work Central and Pacific time working hours.

How success is measured

• Year-over-year renewal rate across the assigned portfolio
• Growth in clinical utilization per account (volume, indications, active clinicians)
• On-time, defect-free completion of manual QC for all new customer go-lives
• Time to first value for new customers
• Accuracy and timeliness of account visibility reporting
• Customer satisfaction and reference-ability

Location and travel

Remote, United States. Customer engagement is primarily virtual; expect less than 10% travel for select onsite visits, internal meetings, and key industry conferences.
